name: Iddo
title: The Seer and the Prophet
summary: Iddo was a prophet and seer who served in the kingdom of Judah during the reigns of kings Rehoboam, Abijah, and Solomon. He is known for having written chronicles and prophetic writings that are referenced in the Bible, although these works have not been preserved. He is also mentioned as the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah.

keyEvents.title: Iddo's Visions Concerning Jeroboam
keyEvents.description: Iddo prophesied and wrote visions concerning Jeroboam, son of Nebat, who rebelled against Solomon's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Iddo's Chronicle of Rehoboam
keyEvents.description: Iddo's writings contained genealogies and accounts of King Rehoboam's deeds and events during his reign.

keyEvents.title: Iddo's Account of King Abijah
keyEvents.description: The prophet Iddo also wrote about the deeds of King Abijah, and his writings were used as a historical source in the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Iddo as Grandfather of the Prophet Zechariah
keyEvents.description: Iddo is mentioned as the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah, who prophesied after the exile and was central to the rebuilding of the temple.

keyEvents.title: Iddo Mentioned Among the Returning Priests
keyEvents.description: An Iddo is listed among the priests and Levites who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, showing the family's continued spiritual service.

keyEvents.title: Zechariah Identified as a Descendant of Iddo
keyEvents.description: The prophet Zechariah is identified as the son of Berechiah, son of Iddo, when the word of the Lord came to him in the second year of King Darius.
